program:
move    10, R0            # Average iterator. ## storing number of averages in register 0

avg_loop:                               # Beginning of the average loop
    reset_ph                            # Reset the phase of the NCO to 0
    upd_param 200                       # Updates "latched" parameters, then waits for 200 nanoseconds. What is a latched parameter?
    acquire 0, 0, 16384    # Acquires acquisition 0 (1 bin), saves it in bin with index 0 (the only bin), for the 
                                                        # entire duration of the acquisition buffer
    loop    R0, @avg_loop                               # Decrement R0 by 1, if non-zero, jump to the start of avg_loop
                                                        # @avg_loop acts as a sort of pointer to the beginning of the avg_loop

    stop        # Stop the sequence
